The leaders and luminaries of ifrits come from the wise but cruel shuyookhs. These spiteful manipulators lord their might over other genies and twist mortal greed into grief. Ifrit shuyookhs guide the Dominion of Flame with their vicious whims and unwavering belief in ifrit supremacy. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 37 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32 [Ifrit Shuyookh](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2636) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 129 **Perception** +25; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=340) **Skills** [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +25, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +28, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +23, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +25, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +24, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +26, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +23 **Str** +8 **Dex** +4 **Con** +5 **Int** +3 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +5 **Items** _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=10)_, _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=38)_ --- **AC** 36 **Fort** +26 **Ref** +23 **Will** +27 **HP** 300 **Immunities** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) **Weaknesses** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 15, [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165) 15 **Heat of Blazing Wings** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) 5 feet, 4d6 fire damage (DC 31 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex)
**Exploit Regret** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101)) **Trigger** A creature fails an attack against the shuyookh; **Effect** The shuyookh asks the triggering creature if it wishes it had hit. If the creature indicates yes, the shuyookh takes damage as if the attack had hit and the expression of regret makes the shuyookh [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) for 1d4 rounds; they can use their extra action to [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=94), Stride, or Strike. --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 35 feet **Melee** _scimitar_ +31 ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)), **Damage** 2d6+16 slashing plus 4d6 fire **Melee** fist +29 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 1d4+16 bludgeoning plus 4d6 fire **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 35, attack +27 - **Cantrips (7th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Illuminate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1359), [Produce Flame](/Spells.aspx?ID=236) - **4th** [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (×2) - **5th** [Fire's Pathway](/Spells.aspx?ID=1354), [Fireball](/Spells.aspx?ID=119) (at will) - **7th** [Plane Shift](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) (at will; to [Astral Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=8), Elemental Planes, or the [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) only), [Volcanic Eruption](/Spells.aspx?ID=360) - **Constant (5th)** [Tongues](/Spells.aspx?ID=340) **Burning Grasp** ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) When the ifrit [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) or restrains a creature, that creature takes 4d6 fire damage, and takes 4d6 fire damage at the end of each of its turns until freed. **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=8)** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The shuyookh transforms into a Small or Medium fire elemental or reptile, such as a snake. This doesn't affect the shuyookh's statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes. **Combat Grab** **Requirements** The ifrit shuyookh has a hand free; **Effect** The shuyookh makes a melee Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) in the shuyookh's free hand. **Pedantic Wish** ([Downtime](/Traits.aspx?ID=49)) **Frequency** three times per year; **Effect** The shuyookh conducts a _wish_ ritual for the benefit of a mortal, requiring no cost or secondary casters. The shuyookh's result is a success if they succeed at a DC 5 flat check or a failure if not. The shuyookh subverts the wish-maker's true intentions, twisting the phrasing to maximize suffering
Hot Gossip Scion of the noble but disgraced Mishalq family, the ifrit information broker Qalkami Mishalq emerged from exile and returned to the Dominion of Flame following the death of Sultan Suleiman XXII. Qalkami used contacts in the Pathfinder Society to eliminate her rivals in the Cinderfury family and step into a power vacuum of her own creation, expanding her control and influence among the great nobility of Medina Mudii'a.
name: Ifrit Shuyookh
